checks.name: V1 [the disformal coupling shifts BOTH potentials by the same amount] the matter metric is expanded to first order and the two potentials matter actually sees are read off and differenced
checks.measured: Phi~ = Phi + varphi, Psi~ = Psi + varphi, difference = Phi - Psi
checks.reading: both pick up exactly +varphi, so the scalar cancels out of the difference. A CONFORMAL coupling shifts only the time potential and would not do this

checks.name: V2 [hence the post-Newtonian gamma is exactly one] with no anisotropic stress in the Einstein frame the two metric potentials are equal, and the ratio matter sees is formed and compared with 1
checks.reading: light bending and Shapiro delay are exactly general-relativistic however strong the scalar is. This is the TeVeS mechanism, obtained here without adding a vector field: the cuscuton clock already carries the unit timelike direction it needs, and carries no propagating scalar of its own

checks.name: V3 [boosting turns the disformal term into a gravitomagnetic one] the mixed time-space component of the matter metric is formed for a system moving through the clock's frame, and its orders in the velocity and in the scalar are both measured
checks.measured: gtilde_0i = 4*varphi*w, order in w = 1, order in varphi = 1
checks.reading: first order in the velocity, which is exactly the preferred-frame signature. The coefficient is 4 varphi, so the effect is proportional to the scalar's share of the local potential

checks.name: V4 [and undragged, it misses the bound by five orders] matching to the post-Newtonian form gives the preferred-frame parameter in terms of the scalar's share of the local potential, which is evaluated at the share MOND requires (order unity at solar-system accelerations) and compared with the bound
checks.measured: alpha_1 = 8*f_s = 8.0 at f_s = 1, bound = 1e-04, over by 8.0e+04
checks.reading: so a clock that stays in the cosmic frame is excluded outright. This is the same wall that killed the vector-based completions, reached here by the same route

checks.name: V5 [THE GATE, restated as one requirement on the clock] the residual misalignment velocity between the clock's frame and the local matter frame that would saturate the bound is solved for, and compared with the solar system's own velocity through the cosmic frame
checks.measured: v_residual <= 4.6 m/s against v_cosmic = 370 km/s, an alignment of 1 part in 8e+04
checks.reading: the gate is not a yes or no about the coupling. It is a single quantitative requirement on how tightly local matter drags the clock into its own rest frame: to better than five metres per second. Whether the clock's own field equation delivers that is NOT computed here

checks.name: V6 [what the board now says] the open items are listed and counted, and the count compared against zero, since a board with nothing open would be a claim this programme is not entitled to make
checks.measured: 2 open: ['solar system: the clock alignment of V5, uncomputed', 'kappa: provably underivable by this class (theorem, not a gap)']
checks.reading: every other gate carries a computed number. The solar-system gate has gone from blocked to a single number that one further calculation would decide
